context.body: Intimate knowledge and presence lead into difficult hostility and renewed self-exposure.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD knows speech and movement, is present across height and depth, forms life in the womb, and is invited to search the speaker.
observations.label: God knows, surrounds, and examines: action

observations.body: The speaker moves from wonder and attempted escape to hatred of enemies and a request for examination.
observations.label: God knows, surrounds, and examines: response

observations.body: searched me · where could I flee? · formed me · lead me
observations.label: Words in Psalm 139:1–24

payload.posture: Read Psalm 139:1–24 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer’s hatred is voiced before God but is not automatically endorsed as God’s own judgment.
payload.title: God knows, surrounds, and examines
